_note: 1.3.0 reputation (owner brainstorm, approved 2026-09-25; docs/design/reputation.md). Replaces Public/Dorm (Dorm is scrapped; Student replaces it). Single source for the engine, the Now entry and the UI. Rep XP is signed and clamps at +-cap; the level is the number of thresholds reached (symmetric). Repeatable triggers give at most weekly_cap Rep XP a week per reputation; events and penalties are uncapped; bond milestones count only while the level is below bond_cap_level. 1.3.1 (owner playtest): a bond reaching tension_high costs tension_xp and reaching tension_max (maximum Tension) another tension_max_xp, mirroring the bond milestones (staff Academy, students Student, Milena Doves). Settings (data/tuning.json) can change the pace, the weekly cap, the milestones and the tension penalty.
_also: 1.53.0 (narrator-load audit U7): a deed whose second side always comes with it; the engine adds that side itself (same Why) unless it was reported too.

competition._note: 1.44.0 (audit 3.13, owner decision by silence): the engine pays a competition result's deed itself when Competition.Status changes, once a year each ('Tier:Status' -> deed; the narrator no longer reports these kinds). A title has a price: the staff expect {{user}} to defend it, and the next elimination at that tier or below costs Academy Rep XP (expect, by the title's tier). Teammates (Competition.Team) gain team_xp bond XP once a year per tier, when the team's result at that tier comes in (qualified, eliminated or champion).
